svg.title: Replace the framework. Keep your research.
svg.desc: v1.4.5 file ownership and backup boundaries
svg.text: Spark2Groundwork / v1.4.5 / FILE OWNERSHIP
Replace the framework. Keep your research.
Identify ownership before updating; public tools and project content have different roles.
FRAMEWORK / Replace packages using the update guide
governance/
Working rules, review guidance and ledger specifications
profiles/ · prompts/
Working profiles and prompt templates
scripts/ · docs/
Checks, startup help and operating guides
README.md · SETUP.md
Project entry and setup; plus init prompt and framework index
Windows/Mac launchers are framework files too. Preserve any local customisations first.
Below the red line: project-owned content. Do not overwrite it with new templates.
YOUR PROJECT / Keep a separate, complete backup
PROJECT.md · FIRST_IDEA.md
Research direction, boundaries and original idea
corpus/ · corpus_md/ · ledgers/
Sources, extracted text, conjectures and claims
my/ · my/tools/
Custom rules, incidents, index and your own tools
handoffs/ · NEXT_SESSION_MEMO.md
Handoff records and the working memo
Also includes governance_config.json, research drafts and any folders you create.
Before an update: back up the whole folder, including hidden files, outside the project. Git is not a full backup.
Merge .gitignore and .gitattributes changes with your settings; do not replace them wholesale.
